summary: Hexcel Corp filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026 reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting held on May 14, 2026. Stockholders elected all nine director nominees, approved on an advisory basis the 2025 compensation of named executive officers, and approved the Hexcel Long-Term Incentive Plan as amended, authorizing 3,015,000 shares for awards and capping non-employee director compensation at $750,000 per year. This is a routine meeting outcome with no special-situation event such as a forced management change or strategic transaction. The filing covers standard corporate governance matters and compensatory arrangements.
